description: Positions that exposed distinct V3 search and evaluation failures in rated games.

positions.label: Corundum AI, White move 20
positions.diagnosis: The one-ply evaluation favours Bxf4, but V3 search selects Bg4 through depth 9.

positions.label: Corundum AI, White move 39
positions.diagnosis: V3 continues to select Qc2 at three million nodes, losing a large positional advantage.

positions.label: Corundum AI, White move 43
positions.diagnosis: The checking move Qc7 permits mate; V3 changes to Kg1 only at substantially greater depth.

positions.label: Negamaximus, Black move 37
positions.diagnosis: V3 selects g6 through depth 12 instead of converting the rook ending with Rxb2.
